Fitting the relaxing component with an exponential decay yields an effective relaxation time of approximately 2.5 min (148 s), substantially longer than the 27–29 s relaxation observed following 20 pulses.
CLM-PHOT-0202.statement: Fitting the relaxing component after 1000 pulses yields an effective relaxation time of approximately 2.5 min.

extra_quotes: Transmission spectra were recorded after electrical excitation, and the resonance displacement was defined as Δλ=λr−λr,0 where λr,0 and λr denote the initial and programmed resonance wavelengths, respectively.
Unless otherwise specified, all measurements were performed at room temperature under ambient conditions.

Further optimization of the electrode geometry, CCPS thickness, and optical-mode overlap could also be explored to reduce the programming voltage and pulse duration and to improve state reproducibility.
